page.title: Service directory
page.subtitle: Trusted local providers for your accommodation

emptyState.noTrades: No providers available for your destinations yet.

date.label: What day was the service?

errors.dateRequired: Pick the day of the service.

success.body: We asked {{name}} to confirm the use. Once they do, you'll be able to review them.

notFound.title: We couldn't find this provider
notFound.body: The code you scanned doesn't match any provider in the directory. Check that it's the right code.

revoked.body: They're no longer part of the directory, so you can't record uses of their benefit. Get in touch if you have questions.
